title: eulophia clavicornis var. inaequalis
intro: Eulophia clavicornis var. inaequalis, commonly known as the Yellow Spider Orchid, is a species of orchid that belongs to the Eulophia genus. This plant is known for its therapeutic properties, which include providing relief from fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Eulophia clavicornis var. inaequalis include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate cough, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids and flavonoids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
